    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # Generalised checks for whether a status problem can be inflicted
    4   #=============================================================================
    5   # NOTE: Not all "does it have this status?" checks use this method. If the
    6   #       check is leading up to curing self of that status condition, then it
    7   #       will look at the value of @status directly instead - if it is that
    8   #       status condition then it is curable. This method only checks for
    9   #       "counts as having that status", which includes Comatose which can't be
   10   #       cured.
   11   def pbHasStatus?(checkStatus)
   12     if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusCheckNonIgnorable(self.ability, self, checkStatus)
   13       return true
   14     end
   15     return @status == checkStatus
   16   end
   17 
   18   def pbHasAnyStatus?
   19     if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusCheckNonIgnorable(self.ability, self, nil)
   20       return true
   21     end
   22     return @status != :NONE
   23   end

   25   def pbCanInflictStatus?(newStatus, user, showMessages, move = nil, ignoreStatus = false)
   26     return false if fainted?
   27     self_inflicted = (user && user.index == @index)   # Rest and Flame Orb/Toxic Orb only
   28     # Already have that status problem
   29     if self.status == newStatus && !ignoreStatus
   30       if showMessages
   31         msg = ""
   32         case self.status
   33         when :SLEEP     then msg = _INTL("{1} is already asleep!", pbThis)
   34         when :POISON    then msg = _INTL("{1} is already poisoned!", pbThis)
   35         when :BURN      then msg = _INTL("{1} already has a burn!", pbThis)
   36         when :PARALYSIS then msg = _INTL("{1} is already paralyzed!", pbThis)
   37         when :FROZEN    then msg = _INTL("{1} is already frozen solid!", pbThis)
   38         end
   39         @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
   40       end
   41       return false
   42     end
   43     # Trying to replace a status problem with another one
   44     if self.status != :NONE && !ignoreStatus && !(self_inflicted && move)   # Rest can replace a status problem
   45       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", pbThis(true))) if showMessages
   46       return false
   47     end
   48     # Trying to inflict a status problem on a Pokémon behind a substitute
   49     if @effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0 && !(move && move.ignoresSubstitute?(user)) &&
   50        !self_inflicted
   51       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", pbThis(true))) if showMessages
   52       return false
   53     end
   54     # Weather immunity
   55     if newStatus == :FROZEN && [:Sun, :HarshSun].include?(effectiveWeather)
   56       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", pbThis(true))) if showMessages
   57       return false
   58     end
   59     # Terrains immunity
   60     if affectedByTerrain?
   61       case @battle.field.terrain
   62       when :Electric
   63         if newStatus == :SLEEP
   64           if showMessages
   65             @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} surrounds itself with electrified terrain!", pbThis(true)))
   66           end
   67           return false
   68         end
   69       when :Misty
   70         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} surrounds itself with misty terrain!", pbThis(true))) if showMessages
   71         return false
   72       end
   73     end
   74     # Uproar immunity
   75     if newStatus == :SLEEP && !(hasActiveAbility?(:SOUNDPROOF) && !@battle.moldBreaker)
   76       @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
   77         next if b.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] == 0
   78         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But the uproar kept {1} awake!", pbThis(true))) if showMessages
   79         return false
   80       end
   81     end
   82     # Type immunities
   83     hasImmuneType = false
   84     case newStatus
   85     when :SLEEP
   86       # No type is immune to sleep
   87     when :POISON
   88       if !(user && user.hasActiveAbility?(:CORROSION))
   89         hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:POISON)
   90         hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:STEEL)
   91       end
   92     when :BURN
   93       hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:FIRE)
   94     when :PARALYSIS
   95       hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:ELECTRIC) && Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS
   96     when :FROZEN
   97       hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:ICE)
   98     end
   99     if hasImmuneType
  100       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", pbThis(true))) if showMessages
  101       return false
  102     end
  103     # Ability immunity
  104     immuneByAbility = false
  105     immAlly = nil
  106     if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunityNonIgnorable(self.ability, self, newStatus)
  107       immuneByAbility = true
  108     elsif self_inflicted || !@battle.moldBreaker
  109       if abilityActive? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunity(self.ability, self, newStatus)
  110         immuneByAbility = true
  111       else
  112         allAllies.each do |b|
  113           next if !b.abilityActive?
  114           next if !Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunityFromAlly(b.ability, self, newStatus)
  115           immuneByAbility = true
  116           immAlly = b
  117           break
  118         end
  119       end
  120     end
  121     if immuneByAbility
  122       if showMessages
  123         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(immAlly || self)
  124         msg = ""
  125         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  126           case newStatus
  127           when :SLEEP     then msg = _INTL("{1} stays awake!", pbThis)
  128           when :POISON    then msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be poisoned!", pbThis)
  129           when :BURN      then msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be burned!", pbThis)
  130           when :PARALYSIS then msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be paralyzed!", pbThis)
  131           when :FROZEN    then msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be frozen solid!", pbThis)
  132           end
  133         elsif immAlly
  134           case newStatus
  135           when :SLEEP
  136             msg = _INTL("{1} stays awake because of {2}'s {3}!",
  137                         pbThis, immAlly.pbThis(true), immAlly.abilityName)
  138           when :POISON
  139             msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be poisoned because of {2}'s {3}!",
  140                         pbThis, immAlly.pbThis(true), immAlly.abilityName)
  141           when :BURN
  142             msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be burned because of {2}'s {3}!",
  143                         pbThis, immAlly.pbThis(true), immAlly.abilityName)
  144           when :PARALYSIS
  145             msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be paralyzed because of {2}'s {3}!",
  146                         pbThis, immAlly.pbThis(true), immAlly.abilityName)
  147           when :FROZEN
  148             msg = _INTL("{1} cannot be frozen solid because of {2}'s {3}!",
  149                         pbThis, immAlly.pbThis(true), immAlly.abilityName)
  150           end
  151         else
  152           case newStatus
  153           when :SLEEP     then msg = _INTL("{1} stays awake because of its {2}!", pbThis, abilityName)
  154           when :POISON    then msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents poisoning!", pbThis, abilityName)
  155           when :BURN      then msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents burns!", pbThis, abilityName)
  156           when :PARALYSIS then msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents paralysis!", pbThis, abilityName)
  157           when :FROZEN    then msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents freezing!", pbThis, abilityName)
  158           end
  159         end
  160         @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  161         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(immAlly || self)
  162       end
  163       return false
  164     end
  165     # Safeguard immunity
  166     if pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Safeguard] > 0 && !self_inflicted && move &&
  167        !(user && user.hasActiveAbility?(:INFILTRATOR))
  168       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s team is protected by Safeguard!", pbThis)) if showMessages
  169       return false
  170     end
  171     return true
  172   end

  174   def pbCanSynchronizeStatus?(newStatus, user)
  175     return false if fainted?
  176     # Trying to replace a status problem with another one
  177     return false if self.status != :NONE
  178     # Terrain immunity
  179     return false if @battle.field.terrain == :Misty && affectedByTerrain?
  180     # Type immunities
  181     hasImmuneType = false
  182     case newStatus
  183     when :POISON
  184       # NOTE: user will have Synchronize, so it can't have Corrosion.
  185       if !(user && user.hasActiveAbility?(:CORROSION))
  186         hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:POISON)
  187         hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:STEEL)
  188       end
  189     when :BURN
  190       hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:FIRE)
  191     when :PARALYSIS
  192       hasImmuneType |= pbHasType?(:ELECTRIC) && Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS
  193     end
  194     return false if hasImmuneType
  195     # Ability immunity
  196     if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunityNonIgnorable(self.ability, self, newStatus)
  197       return false
  198     end
  199     if abilityActive? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunity(self.ability, self, newStatus)
  200       return false
  201     end
  202     allAllies.each do |b|
  203       next if !b.abilityActive?
  204       next if !Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunityFromAlly(b.ability, self, newStatus)
  205       return false
  206     end
  207     # Safeguard immunity
  208     # NOTE: user will have Synchronize, so it can't have Infiltrator.
  209     if pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Safeguard] > 0 &&
  210        !(user && user.hasActiveAbility?(:INFILTRATOR))
  211       return false
  212     end
  213     return true
  214   end

  216   #=============================================================================
  217   # Generalised infliction of status problem
  218   #=============================================================================
  219   def pbInflictStatus(newStatus, newStatusCount = 0, msg = nil, user = nil)
  220     # Inflict the new status
  221     self.status      = newStatus
  222     self.statusCount = newStatusCount
  223     @effects[PBEffects::Toxic] = 0
  224     # Show animation
  225     if newStatus == :POISON && newStatusCount > 0
  226       @battle.pbCommonAnimation("Toxic", self)
  227     else
  228       anim_name = GameData::Status.get(newStatus).animation
  229       @battle.pbCommonAnimation(anim_name, self) if anim_name
  230     end
  231     # Show message
  232     if msg && !msg.empty?
  233       @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  234     else
  235       case newStatus
  236       when :SLEEP
  237         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} fell asleep!", pbThis))
  238       when :POISON
  239         if newStatusCount > 0
  240           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was badly poisoned!", pbThis))
  241         else
  242           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was poisoned!", pbThis))
  243         end
  244       when :BURN
  245         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was burned!", pbThis))
  246       when :PARALYSIS
  247         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is paralyzed! It may be unable to move!", pbThis))
  248       when :FROZEN
  249         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was frozen solid!", pbThis))
  250       end
  251     end
  252     PBDebug.log("[Status change] #{pbThis}'s sleep count is #{newStatusCount}") if newStatus == :SLEEP
  253     # Form change check
  254     pbCheckFormOnStatusChange
  255     # Synchronize
  256     if abilityActive?
  257       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnStatusInflicted(self.ability, self, user, newStatus)
  258     end
  259     # Status cures
  260     pbItemStatusCureCheck
  261     pbAbilityStatusCureCheck
  262     # Petal Dance/Outrage/Thrash get cancelled immediately by falling asleep
  263     # NOTE: I don't know why this applies only to Outrage and only to falling
  264     #       asleep (i.e. it doesn't cancel Rollout/Uproar/other multi-turn
  265     #       moves, and it doesn't cancel any moves if self becomes frozen/
  266     #       disabled/anything else). This behaviour was tested in Gen 5.
  267     if @status == :SLEEP && @effects[PBEffects::Outrage] > 0
  268       @effects[PBEffects::Outrage] = 0
  269       @currentMove = nil
  270     end
  271   end

  276   def asleep?
  277     return pbHasStatus?(:SLEEP)
  278   end
  279 
  280   def pbCanSleep?(user, showMessages, move = nil, ignoreStatus = false)
  281     return pbCanInflictStatus?(:SLEEP, user, showMessages, move, ignoreStatus)
  282   end
  283 
  284   def pbCanSleepYawn?
  285     return false if self.status != :NONE
  286     if affectedByTerrain? && [:Electric, :Misty].include?(@battle.field.terrain)
  287       return false
  288     end
  289     if !hasActiveAbility?(:SOUNDPROOF) && @battle.allBattlers.any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] > 0 }
  290       return false
  291     end
  292     if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunityNonIgnorable(self.ability, self, :SLEEP)
  293       return false
  294     end
  295     # NOTE: Bulbapedia claims that Flower Veil shouldn't prevent sleep due to
  296     #       drowsiness, but I disagree because that makes no sense. Also, the
  297     #       comparable Sweet Veil does prevent sleep due to drowsiness.
  298     if abilityActive? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunity(self.ability, self, :SLEEP)
  299       return false
  300     end
  301     allAllies.each do |b|
  302       next if !b.abilityActive?
  303       next if !Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunityFromAlly(b.ability, self, :SLEEP)
  304       return false
  305     end
  306     # NOTE: Bulbapedia claims that Safeguard shouldn't prevent sleep due to
  307     #       drowsiness. I disagree with this too. Compare with the other sided
  308     #       effects Misty/Electric Terrain, which do prevent it.
  309     return false if pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Safeguard] > 0
  310     return true
  311   end

  313   def pbSleep(msg = nil)
  314     pbInflictStatus(:SLEEP, pbSleepDuration, msg)

  317   def pbSleepSelf(msg = nil, duration = -1)
  318     pbInflictStatus(:SLEEP, pbSleepDuration(duration), msg)

  321   def pbSleepDuration(duration = -1)
  322     duration = 2 + @battle.pbRandom(3) if duration <= 0
  323     duration = (duration / 2).floor if hasActiveAbility?(:EARLYBIRD)
  324     return duration
  325   end
